scope: Ki Blast Ultimate coverage expansion — current high-confidence records

records.name: Final Flash (SS3 DAIMA)
records.effect: Final Flash whose input can consume additional Ki beyond the initial cost to substantially increase its power.

records.name: Super Kamehameha (SS4 DAIMA)
records.effect: Super Kamehameha variant that can consume an additional 100 Ki during input for an extended, more powerful attack.

records.name: Thunder Flash
records.effect: Chargeable Ki wave that can consume additional Ki while held to extend the attack and increase damage.

records.name: Prominence Flash
records.effect: Chargeable Ki wave whose damage increases through repeated activations, up to a stated maximum.

records.name: Mystic Flash
records.effect: Rear-facing Ki wave that is fired behind the user rather than forward.

notes: Five additional Ki Blast Ultimate identities were researched from current Xenoverse 2-specific wiki pages on 2026-09-18. Ultimate Finish requirements and CaC availability remain null where the consulted source did not explicitly establish them.
